{{Top}}
The '''Republic Enforcement DataCore''' was a database maintained by the [[Republic Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was replaced by the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Enforcement DataCore]].
